outline.chapter_title: Foundational Concepts in Sequential Language Modeling
outline.description: Introduces the probabilistic framework underlying language models and summarizes why traditional feed‐forward networks struggle with sequential dependencies.
subtopics: vanishing/exploding gradients in naïve seq nets

outline.chapter_title: Classic Long Short Term Memory Architecture
outline.description: Presents the canonical LSTM unit, elucidating its gates and dynamics that preserve gradients over long horizons.

outline.chapter_title: Three Core Shortcomings of Standard LSTMs
outline.description: Explains concrete limitations identified experimentally that motivate extensions.
subtopics: revisions discarded during storage updates (nearest neighbor search issue)
limited scalar storage when predicting rare events
serial nature preventing efficient hardware parallelisation
outline.descriptionsession: With increasing context lengths these problems expose architectures’ bottlenecks.

outline.chapter_title: Design Principles Behind Extended Long Short Term Memory
outline.description: Outlines the objectives guiding xLSTM construction – mitigating revision limits through exponential gating and enlarging storage through matrix memories.
subtopics: requirement analysis leading to exponential gates
overview of scalar versus matrix memory structures
